title: fix(plugin-auth): with SSO domain verification on, the domain-verification doors answer an unknown provider 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND
body:
Fixes #22463
Clause-②: yes (widening)

## What changed

With `OS_SSO_DOMAIN_VERIFICATION` on, `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/sso/request-domain-verification` and `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/sso/verify-domain` answered an unknown `providerId` with `400 DOMAIN_VERIFICATION_DISABLED` ("set OS_SSO_DOMAIN_VERIFICATION"), telling the operator to turn on a feature that was already on. `@better-auth/sso` 1.7.3 answers both an unmounted route (feature off) and an unknown provider (feature on, `checkProviderAccess`) with a `404` that carries no `code`, and both bridges mapped every such `404` to the feature-off answer.

Following triage `6079484598`, the bridges now decide from the environment's own setting, never from the vendor's 404 body:

- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/register-sso-provider.ts`: `runRequestDomainVerification` and `runVerifyDomain` take an optional third argument, `{ domainVerificationEnabled?: boolean }`.
  - `false`: `400 DOMAIN_VERIFICATION_DISABLED`, returned after the existing input checks and before any vendor call.
  - `true`: a code-less vendor `404` is the provider lookup missing, answered `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` with the message `SSO provider "ID" was not found.` A `404` that carries a code (`NO_PENDING_VERIFICATION`) is still the vendor's answer and passes through.
  - omitted: the earlier mapping, byte for byte. The cloud auth proxy mounts these exported helpers and hands no flag, so it sees no change.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-plugin.ts`: the two mounts hand `this.authManager!.isSsoDomainVerificationEnabled()`, read after `gateAdmin`, so the gate still answers first.
- No new error code. `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` is `HttpStatusErrorCodeMap[404]`; `check:error-status-conformance` derives the new site (`register-sso-provider.ts:381`, `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` at `404`) and stays green.
- `admin-sso-bridge-gate.test.ts`: its stand-in auth manager gains `isSsoDomainVerificationEnabled: () => true` (its vendor runs `sso({ domainVerification: { enabled: true } })`); the mounts now read that seam after the gate.

## Reproduction (before), on the mounted route

`origin/main` `f66c440de`: the plugin's real `registerAuthRoutes` on Hono, a real `AuthManager` (better-auth 1.7.3, `@better-auth/sso` 1.7.3), legacy-`role` platform admin by bearer, body `{ "providerId": "no-such-provider-22463" }`.

| flag | door | vendor's inner answer | door's answer |
|---|---|---|---|
| on | `request-domain-verification` | `404 {"message":"Provider not found"}` | `400 DOMAIN_VERIFICATION_DISABLED` |
| on | `verify-domain` | `404 {"message":"Provider not found"}` | `400 DOMAIN_VERIFICATION_DISABLED` |
| off (SSO on) | `request-domain-verification` | `404`, empty body | `400 DOMAIN_VERIFICATION_DISABLED` |
| off (SSO on) | `verify-domain` | `404`, empty body | `400 DOMAIN_VERIFICATION_DISABLED` |

## Pins

Real stack: `sso-domain-verification-unknown-provider.pin.test.ts` (new). Two real `AuthManager`s over the shared in-memory engine (`ssoDomainVerification` on, and SSO on with it off), each behind the plugin's real route registration on Hono. Vendor calls are counted on `AuthManager.handleRequest`, filtered to the inner path.

| pin | answer |
|---|---|
| precondition | the flag reads `true` / `false` on the two stacks; the vendor's two code-less 404 shapes, measured live |
| ON, unknown provider, both doors | `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`, message names the provider, vendor asked once |
| OFF, both doors (control) | `400 DOMAIN_VERIFICATION_DISABLED`, vendor never asked |
| ON, the admin's own provider, `request-domain-verification` | the vendor's `201` becomes the `200` DNS record |
| ON, the admin's own provider, `verify-domain` | the vendor's coded `404 NO_PENDING_VERIFICATION` passes through, not `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` |
| anonymous, both doors, ON and OFF | `401 UNAUTHENTICATED`, vendor never asked |
| a bridge handed no flag, real ON stack, both bridges | `400 DOMAIN_VERIFICATION_DISABLED`, as before |

Unit (`sso-domain-verification-error-codes.test.ts`, fake vendor): the same three flag states on both bridges, plus: ON with an empty or reworded 404 body gives the same not-found answer (the decision does not read the wording), and OFF still answers a missing `providerId` with `400 INVALID_REQUEST` first.

## Ablations

Each leg ran through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit and landing proven on disk) on the committed fix (`527974a2c`), against the two pin files. Every restore was proven: blob equal to the `HEAD` blob, `git diff HEAD` empty, no other file in `git status`. The pins import the subject by relative path, so no `dist/` is involved.

| leg | mutation | red | failing output |
|---|---|---|---|
| A1 (card's) | the any-404 mapping restored: every code-less 404 answers DISABLED again | 6: the card's pin on both doors, real and unit, plus both wording pins | `expected 'DOMAIN_VERIFICATION_DISABLED' to be 'RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND'`; `expected 400 to be 404` |
| A2 | the off early return deleted (both bridges) | 4: OFF "vendor never asked", real and unit, both doors | `expected 1 to be +0` |
| A3 | the mounts hand no flag | 4: the card's pin and the OFF control, real stack, both doors | `expected 400 to be 404`; `expected 1 to be +0` |
| A4 | every ON 404 read as not-found, coded or not | 2: `NO_PENDING_VERIFICATION` passes through, real and unit | `expected 'RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND' to be 'NO_PENDING_VERIFICATION'` |
| A5 | a missing flag read as on | 7: the no-flag pins, real and unit, plus the three earlier DISABLED pins | `expected 'RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND' to be 'DOMAIN_VERIFICATION_DISABLED'` |
| A6 | a capability answer moved ahead of `gateAdmin` on the request mount | 2: anonymous OFF on that door, and the OFF control's message | `expected 400 to be 401` |

A6's first attempt was a no-op: the replacement re-contained the anchor, the tool refused it (exit 1) before any test ran, and the leg was re-run with an anchor-free replacement.

The ablations also caught a dead counter in the first draft of the real-stack pins. `impersonation-bearer-rotation.test.ts` (where `createMemoryEngine` lives) registers `afterEach(() => vi.restoreAllMocks())` in every file that imports it, so a `vi.spyOn` counter was stripped after the first test, and every "vendor never asked" pin passed on a dead counter. The "vendor asked once" legs turned red on it. The counter is now a plain instance wrapper, and A2 and A3 show it reads.

## Wall time

Shared-box seconds, `vitest run --maxWorkers=2`, one file per run:

- `in-process-session-renewal.pin.test.ts` (not edited): 20.65 s before (`f66c440de`, 39 tests), 19.74 s after (`dd583360b`, 39 tests).
- `sso-domain-verification-unknown-provider.pin.test.ts` (new): 18.58 s, 25 tests. 15 are its own; the other 10 are `impersonation-bearer-rotation.test.ts`'s, which every importer of `createMemoryEngine` runs again.

## Verification

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` at `527974a2c`: 135 files, 2766 passed, 10 skipped. The merge of `main` (`dd583360b`) brought only `scripts/pm/fleet-write/**`, `.github/workflows/fleet-write.yml` and one `.claude` reference doc.
- The four affected files at `dd583360b`: 111 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth typecheck` at `527974a2c` (src, examples, test layer): green. The emitted `.d.ts` adds only the optional third parameter; the two helper types are not exported.
- Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` at `dd583360b` derived 68. 67 exit 0. One is NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exits 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET) because it needs every package's `dist/`, and this worktree built only `plugin-auth`'s closure. `--ran` reconciliation: 68 accounted for, 0 unrun. The four artifact-roster families whose roster sits in a touched directory (`check-changeset-fixed`, `check:authz-resolver`, `check:error-code-casing`, `check:filter-alias-parity`) also exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- **`authInstance` boundary.** `isSsoDomainVerificationEnabled()` reads `config.plugins` and the env, the same expressions `buildPluginList` uses, and `applyConfigPatch` discards the built instance when they change, so the flag tracks what is mounted. A host that hands `AuthManagerOptions.authInstance` (a pre-built better-auth instance) is not described by that config: with domain verification on in its instance but not in its config, the mounts would now answer DISABLED without asking the vendor. Zero in-repo producers of `authInstance` (`git grep` at `dd583360b`: the declaration and its one use in `auth-manager.ts`). Owner: none.
- **The cloud auth proxy** is not measured: this session cannot read `objectstack-ai/cloud`. It hands no flag, so its answers are unchanged; it gets the not-found answer only once it passes `{ domainVerificationEnabled }`.
- **`DOMAIN_VERIFICATION_FAILED` on the real stack** (the vendor's 502 when the DNS TXT record is missing) is not pinned here: it needs a DNS lookup. The unit pins cover the 502 path, unchanged.
- **Test-harness trap, observation only.** Importing `createMemoryEngine` from `impersonation-bearer-rotation.test.ts` brings that file's 10 tests and its `afterEach(restoreAllMocks)` into each of the 15 importers. A lexical scan of the other 14 for a non-console `vi.spyOn` inside `beforeAll` found none; it does not see spies set inside helpers called from `beforeAll`, which was this PR's shape. Owner: none.
- Dogfood expectations are unchanged: with SSO off, the flag is false and both doors still answer `400 DOMAIN_VERIFICATION_DISABLED`, now without a vendor call.
